quarterly_data.quarter: Mastercard press release: Mastercard and BVNK Launch Global Money Platform to Power a (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mastercard and BVNK launched Mastercard Global Money Platform, available now through BVNK and the first major integration of the two since the August 2026 acquisition: one API for multi-currency accounts holding fiat and stablecoins, real-time conversion, stablecoin-linked cards (issuing in 130-plus countries) and local bank payouts through Mastercard Move, which reaches more than 17 billion endpoints and is expected to cover more than 40 currencies across 200-plus countries and territories in 2027. Nuvei and Marqeta will be among the first to integrate it, alongside Ontop, Beem and Almond FinTech.
quarterly_data.figure: Mastercard Move reaches more than 17 billion endpoints; 40+ currencies in 2027
